notes.body:
Rapamycin body model
Whole-body model of rapamycin (sirolimus) with the blood circulation, the tissue distribution and the submodels of the intestine, the liver and the kidneys.
The circulating species are whole blood concentrations: rapamycin is bound in the erythrocytes (FKBP12, blood to plasma ratio 36-142), nearly all studies measure whole blood. The blood flows transport the blood concentrations, the plasma concentration is the blood concentration over the blood to plasma ratio BP_rap.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

parameter.name: rate of the slow binding rap (tissue)

body.p: The release of the bound rapamycin of the tissue limits the terminal phase: the concentrations fall by a factor of about 10 in the first day after a dose (distribution) and with a half-life of about 60 hr after it.
The value of kdeep_rap is the result of the fit PK_20261017_094949__24b18, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

scaling factor for renal function. 1.0: normal renal function; <1.0: reduced renal function

parameter.name: rate urinary excretion of rapamycin metabolites
rate of the biliary excretion of the rapamycin metabolites

body.p: The biliary clearance of the metabolites is about 5 times their renal clearance (KI__RXEX_k): after an oral dose of 14C-rapamycin 91 % of the radioactivity is recovered in the feces and 2.2 % in the urine (Leung2006), and most of the fecal radioactivity is formed in the gut wall or not absorbed.

parameter.name: rate of rapamycin metabolism by CYP3A4

body.p: Intrinsic clearance of CYP3A4 per volume of the liver, of whole blood concentrations. The metabolism is linear: the Km of the microsomes (8.07 µM, Sattler1992) is far above the concentrations of the therapeutic doses.
The value of LI__RAP2RX_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_094949__24b18, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The fraction of functional CYP3A5 alleles: *3/*3 = 0 (no functional CYP3A5, the reference, most Caucasians), *1/*3 = 0.5, *1/*1 = 1.

parameter.name: fraction of the enterocytes of the intestine volume

body.p: Fraction of the rapamycin leaving the lumen which is absorbed into the enterocytes, the rest is excreted with the feces. Together with the metabolism of the gut wall it sets the oral bioavailability of about 14 % (Rapamune label); the split between the fraction absorbed and the gut wall cannot be identified from oral data and is assumed.

The dose is taken in the fasted state (0) or with a high fat meal (1). The effects of food on the dissolution and gastric emptying and on the fraction absorbed are FED_f_dissolution and FED_f_absorption.

rate of rapamycin transport from the enterocytes into the blood
rate of rapamycin metabolism by CYP3A4 (gut wall)

body.p: Intrinsic clearance of CYP3A4 per volume of the enterocytes. The metabolism is linear: the Km of the microsomes (8.07 µM, Sattler1992) is above the concentrations of the enterocytes after the therapeutic doses.
The fraction of functional CYP3A5 alleles: *3/*3 = 0 (no functional CYP3A5, the reference, most Caucasians), *1/*3 = 0.5, *1/*1 = 1.

parameter.name: rate of rapamycin efflux by P-glycoprotein
rate of the release of the metabolites into the lumen
rate of the transit of the metabolites to the feces

body.p: The metabolites pass the lumen and the chain of the colon in (n_chain + 1)/RXEXC_k, about 30 hr; the fecal radioactivity of 14C-rapamycin is excreted within 24-72 hr (Leung2006).
The value of GU__Ka_dis_rap is the result of the fit PK_20261017_094949__24b18, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
